definitions.explanation: Cloth woven from silk thread. A somewhat formal or literary word; everyday speech usually says {絹|きぬ} or シルク.

examples.japanese: {絹布|けんぷ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧。
examples.english: A kimono made of silk cloth.

examples.japanese: {絹布|けんぷ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手触|てざわ}り→手触り：12758_tezawari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧なめらかだ。
examples.english: Silk cloth feels smooth to the touch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧、{絹布|けんぷ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高価|こうか}→高価：02796_kouka⟧で、⟦{限|かぎ}られた→限る：02033_kagiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧しか⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧につけられなかった。
examples.english: In the past, silk cloth was expensive and only a select few could wear it.

notes:
Cloth woven from silk. A formal or literary word; in daily life people say ⟦{絹|きぬ}→絹：01383_kinu⟧ or ⟦シルク→シルク：28530_shiruku⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絹布|けんぷ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧: a silk-cloth kimono
- ⟦{上等|じょうとう}→上等：03821_joutou⟧な{絹布|けんぷ}: fine silk fabric

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{絹|きぬ}→絹：01383_kinu⟧: silk — the everyday word for the material itself
- ⟦{綿布|めんぷ}→綿布：25129_menpu⟧: cotton cloth — the parallel word for cotton
